task: Make bot-created release-unit child PR proof automation-safe by explicitly dispatching exact-head CI and fail fast with machine-readable terminal child-CI blockers instead of polling action_required runs until timeout.

operationalIntelligence.problemStatement: Live bounded rehearsal reached U01 PR_OPEN and created canonical child PR #1024 at head d9530afd343b66ae157444298ae847f1d12fb8dc. GitHub completed the pull_request CI run 37596487318 immediately as action_required because actor and triggering_actor were github-actions[bot], with no normal CI jobs. importExactChildProof only searches for successful exact CI and otherwise returns PENDING, causing the trusted executor to poll for roughly the full global limit with no concrete blocker surfaced.
observableOutcomes: Trusted executor explicitly triggers an exact child proof run through workflow_dispatch after creating or confirming the exact child PR, rather than depending solely on its bot-generated pull_request event.

CI workflow supports a trusted release-unit dispatch mode carrying exact PR number, head SHA, base SHA and head branch, and runs the same canonical gates, Truth and Lifecycle semantics against that exact child head.
release-unit-ci-context validates dispatch identity against the actual same-repository open PR and its signed release-unit envelope before setting child transaction context.
importExactChildProof distinguishes queued/in_progress from terminal non-success and returns machine-readable BLOCK codes such as RELEASE_UNIT_CHILD_CI_ACTION_REQUIRED.
finishActiveUnit persists terminal child proof failures as STALE with the exact blocker instead of waiting until RELEASE_UNIT_EXECUTION_POLL_LIMIT.
Operator logs/state surface the exact machine blocker without an extra GitHub API query.
unresolvedRisks: A dispatch proof could run on main rather than the exact child head if workflow ref/inputs are not bound correctly.
Dispatch inputs are untrusted strings unless reconciled to the actual PR and release-unit envelope.
Accepting any successful CI run for the commit could confuse ordinary pull_request CI with trusted dispatch proof identity.
Repeated polling must not dispatch duplicate proof runs every cycle.
Terminal action_required handling must not mark genuine queued/in_progress proof as failed.
A stale PR must not be merged after main advances; normal fresh reevaluation/superseding branch semantics must remain authoritative.

in: Add workflow_dispatch inputs to CI for trusted release-unit proof: PR number, child head SHA, base SHA and head branch.
Normalize CI effective PR/head/base/branch identity so pull_request and trusted dispatch modes run the same gates/artifacts.
Extend release-unit-ci-context to resolve trusted dispatch PR identity and validate same repository/open/exact head/base/ref plus release-unit body envelope.
After ensureExactPullRequest, idempotently ensure an exact workflow_dispatch child proof run exists.
Classify exact child CI runs into SUCCESS, PENDING or terminal BLOCK with explicit conclusion-derived error codes.
Persist terminal child proof BLOCK as STALE through canonical parent synchronization.
Add regression coverage for action_required fail-fast, pending semantics, dispatch idempotency, exact identity and no manual approval bypass.
out: No manual child PR recreation, state editing, receipt fabrication or merge bypass.
No weakening of Plan/Atlas/Release Risk/Truth/Lifecycle proof.
No changes to storefront, database, payments, inventory, auth product runtime, Builder or templates.

assuranceCeiling.rationale: This is a trusted write-capable release execution edge crossing GitHub Actions event semantics. Dispatch identity, exact-head proof selection, terminal-state classification and fail-closed recovery must all remain machine-verifiable.

acceptanceCriteria: CI supports workflow_dispatch release-unit proof mode without changing ordinary push/pull_request behavior.
Dispatch CI checks out the exact supplied child head and uses the supplied exact base/ref/PR identity for all Development/Truth artifact binding.
release-unit-ci-context fetches and validates the actual PR when invoked in dispatch mode and fails closed on repo/state/head/base/ref mismatch.
Executor creates at most one active/successful exact dispatch proof per child head/branch/PR identity.
importExactChildProof returns BLOCK/RELEASE_UNIT_CHILD_CI_ACTION_REQUIRED for the observed action_required terminal run rather than PENDING.
Queued/in_progress or not-yet-materialized dispatch proof remains PENDING.
finishActiveUnit writes a terminal proof blocker as STALE and the next canonical executor replay can fresh-reevaluate from current main.
Exact-head CI, Completion Truth and Lifecycle close before merge; then the unchanged rehearsal resumes without manual approval.
invariants: Only exact same-repository child PR identity may enter release-unit dispatch proof mode.
Workflow dispatch is proof execution, not proof bypass: all existing canonical gates and Truth/Lifecycle must still PASS.
Terminal non-success child CI is never represented as PENDING.
PENDING never persists a false blocker for genuinely running proof.
No child merge occurs without exact-head VERIFIED_DONE Truth and closed LEARN lifecycle evidence.
No state mutation bypasses persisted CAS synchronization.

failureModes: Bot-created PR pull_request run concludes action_required with zero canonical jobs.
Executor waits for success despite terminal child CI.
Dispatch is triggered repeatedly on every poll.
Dispatch PR identity cannot be validated because pull request permissions are absent.
Ordinary pull_request CI behavior regresses after identity normalization.
edgeCases: Original pull_request CI succeeds before dispatch is needed.
Original pull_request CI is action_required while dispatch proof succeeds.
Dispatch proof is queued or in_progress during several executor polls.
Dispatch proof fails one canonical gate.
Main advances after child PR is opened and terminal proof forces STALE re-evaluation.
Multiple CI runs exist for the same child head with different events/conclusions.

alternatives.summary: Trusted executor explicitly invokes the existing CI workflow in release-unit proof mode on the exact child ref/head.
alternatives.reason: GitHub permits workflow_dispatch from GITHUB_TOKEN, preserves the canonical CI/Truth chain and avoids bot PR event approval semantics.

alternatives.summary: Require a human to approve each bot-created child PR workflow.
alternatives.reason: Breaks autonomous release-unit execution and leaves the rehearsal dependent on manual intervention.

alternatives.summary: Create child PRs with a separate PAT/GitHub App token so pull_request CI triggers normally.
alternatives.reason: Adds secret/credential infrastructure not required to close the current execution edge.

alternatives.summary: Skip GitHub child CI and prove entirely inside the trusted executor worktree.
alternatives.reason: Would reduce production-like PR proof fidelity and duplicate the canonical CI evidence chain.

specialistReviews.finding: The missing edge is event-trigger authority between executor-created PR and child CI, not child materialization or proof semantics.
specialistReviews.resolution: Add explicit trusted dispatch while keeping the existing CI workflow as the single proof implementation.

specialistReviews.finding: workflow_dispatch inputs could let an arbitrary ref/PR impersonate a release-unit child.
specialistReviews.resolution: Dispatch mode must fetch actual PR, require same repo/open/exact head/base/ref and validate the signed release-unit body envelope before any child context is accepted.

specialistReviews.finding: Terminal child workflow conclusions are currently collapsed into PENDING, masking actionable failure and wasting executor time.
specialistReviews.resolution: Classify terminal conclusions immediately and persist exact blocker as STALE for canonical replay.

specialistReviews.finding: Operators currently need separate API/log queries to learn why a proof never progresses.
specialistReviews.resolution: Emit conclusion-derived machine code into executor error/state so the primary run shows the exact cause.

challenge.scenario: github-actions[bot] creates an exact same-repo child PR and GitHub marks pull_request CI action_required.
challenge.finding: Current import returns PENDING forever until poll limit because it only recognizes exact success.
challenge.resolution: Treat action_required as terminal BLOCK with RELEASE_UNIT_CHILD_CI_ACTION_REQUIRED and separately dispatch trusted proof.

challenge.scenario: A dispatch payload names PR #1024 but supplies another head SHA.
challenge.finding: Running proof against mismatched code would break exact transaction identity.
challenge.resolution: Fetch PR in child-context step and compare PR number/repository/state/head/base/ref to dispatch payload before decoding envelope.

challenge.scenario: Both pull_request and dispatch CI exist for one head.
challenge.finding: Proof importer could select the wrong run or keep reacting to action_required despite a valid dispatch success.
challenge.resolution: Prefer exact successful trusted dispatch proof; terminal pull_request action_required only blocks when no valid dispatch proof is active/successful.

challenge.scenario: Executor polls while dispatch proof is queued/in_progress.
challenge.finding: Repeated repository actions could create many identical CI runs.
challenge.resolution: Before dispatch, list exact workflow_dispatch runs for head/branch and create one only when none is queued/in_progress/successful.

challenge.scenario: Dispatch CI fails Plan, test, build or Truth gate.
challenge.finding: The executor needs the exact terminal reason instead of a generic timeout.
challenge.resolution: Map terminal workflow conclusion to RELEASE_UNIT_CHILD_CI_<CONCLUSION>; preserve run id/head/branch in blocker details and stop polling.

challenge.scenario: Old PR_OPEN child was based on an earlier main and receives terminal proof blocker after this fix merges.
challenge.finding: Continuing that old branch would miss the new workflow implementation.
challenge.resolution: Persist STALE on terminal proof; next prepareActiveUnit fresh-reevaluates current main and creates/reuses a superseding canonical child branch containing current workflow code.

challenge.scenario: Dispatch event runs existing CI but github.event.pull_request is absent.
challenge.finding: Current workflow expressions and release-unit-ci-context would bind main/default event identity rather than child identity.
challenge.resolution: Normalize effective head/base/ref/PR values for both pull_request and dispatch modes and use them consistently across checkout, gates, artifacts, Truth and lifecycle.

challenge.scenario: No pull_request CI run is created at all.
challenge.finding: Waiting for a PR-triggered run before dispatch would deadlock.
challenge.resolution: Explicit dispatch is ensured immediately after PR_OPEN creation/confirmation; pull_request CI becomes optional redundant proof rather than required trigger.

proofPlan: Commit this plan only and require Plan Before Code PASS.
Implement dispatch-capable CI identity normalization, child-context validation, explicit proof dispatch and terminal-run classifier.
Add regression tests for observed action_required case, exact dispatch identity, duplicate suppression, PENDING vs BLOCK classification and STALE persistence.
Require exact-head Knowledge/Plan/Edit-Time/Replay/Risk/full tests/typecheck/build/Completion Truth PASS.
Commit only canonical lifecycle closure metadata and require final exact-head CI PASS.
Merge, let the obsolete stuck executor terminate naturally if connector cannot cancel it, then replay the unchanged rehearsal from persisted CAS state.

requirements.requirement: Trusted release-unit child proof must execute automatically on the exact child identity even when the bot-created pull_request workflow is action_required, and terminal child workflow states must surface immediately as machine-readable blockers.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: A terminal exact child CI conclusion may not be represented as PENDING until global poll timeout.
Trusted child proof dispatch may not run against a PR/head/base/ref identity different from the persisted release-unit transaction.

notes: Created from live Failure Intake #1025 after U01 reached PR_OPEN and CI run 37596487318 completed action_required under github-actions[bot], while trusted executor run 37566854069 remained polling in Drive canonical release-unit execution.
